basic_info.name: Simply Fleet

basic_info.name: FleetGuru.ai
basic_info.description: FleetGuru.ai is an AI-powered fleet maintenance platform that unifies workflows across fleets, service providers, and drivers - streamlining maintenance management at scale. Our story starts with AutoGuru in 2014, when founder Eden Shirley set out to make booking a mechanic as easy as booking a hotel. AutoGuru achieved this mission, becoming Australia’s #1 auto services marketplace. From that foundation, FleetGuru was created - a B2B SaaS platform purpose-built to facilitate a seamless digital experience in the world of fleet maintenance. Today, FleetGuru.ai connects enterprise fleet partners, over 12,000 service providers, and drivers through a single intelligent platform. Streamlined bookings, approvals and payments. Powerful data insights. Less admin, more control.Built on the proven infrastructure and marketplace network pioneered by AutoGuru, FleetGuru.ai is redefining how fleet maintenance is managed at scale.

basic_info.name: MaintainRO

With MaintainRO, your assets perform better, your operations run smoother, and your bottom line gets stronger.

basic_info.name: Axion Fleet AI
basic_info.description: Axion Fleet AI is a Canadian owned and operated technology company dedicated to transforming commercial fleet maintenance. Our cloud platform blends real‐time telematics, predictive analytics, and machine‐learning models to give operators a single, cost‐effective hub for every maintenance task—asset lifecycle tracking, automated work‐order creation, parts inventory, and regulatory compliance. Axion Fleet AI delivers customizable dashboards that cut downtime, lower emissions, and keep fleets ready for the demands of tomorrow’s mobility landscape.

basic_info.name: Shift AI
basic_info.description: Shift Technologies Canada Inc. has developed an AI-driven all-in-one fleet management platform to enable businesses to efficiently manage their fleet operations, providing advanced features such as real-time tracking, predictive maintenance, intelligent route planning, AI inspections and more. Shift simplifies fleet management, allowing businesses to focus on their core operations while handling the rest.Key Features of Shift:-Predictive Maintenance: Leveraging data from sensors and historical performance, Shift’s predictive maintenance capabilities forecast potential vehicle issues, allowing for proactive maintenance. This reduces downtime and maintenance costs, extending the overall lifespan of fleet vehicles.-AI Inspections: Through photo analysis, AI algorithms automatically detect damages and assess vehicle condition, streamlining the inspection process and providing accurate, real-time insights. Expanding into video analysis. -Real-Time Tracking and Route Optimization: Provides complete visibility into fleet activities, enabling operators to monitor vehicles, intelligent route planning and ensure efficient dispatching. This results in significant time and fuel savings, enhancing overall productivity.-AI Dashcam: Provide real-time driver monitoring, incident detection, and instant alerts, helping deter theft and unauthorized usage while ensuring comprehensive safety measures.-Seamless Integration with IoT Devices: Shift seamlessly integrates with Internet of Things (IoT) devices, enhancing overall connectivity and providing real-time data from sensors monitoring fuel, tire pressure, engine health, and more.

basic_info.name: ORNG TECH

basic_info.name: FleetPredict
basic_info.description: FleetPredict is an AI-powered predictive maintenance platform designed to transform how commercial fleet maintenance is managed.
